topic: Setting up AI demo code repository
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on setting up the GitHub repository for an AI project demonstration. [p1] requested the creation of a new repo named `geoai-demo` to host code for an AI project demo intended for someone (Esben). [p3] clarified that a repository already exists and provided access details, suggesting either using or renaming the existing one (`allunite/ai-poc-data`).
decisions: Use the existing GitHub repository `allunite/ai-poc-data` for the AI project demo code.
action_items: [p3] to grant access and potentially rename the existing repository.
